description: This file defines an ApprovalService class for managing submission approvals, including e-signature verification, approval/rejection workflows, and related error handling. It interacts with a database, audit, and evidence services, and includes custom exception classes.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: AuthenticationError
classes.description: Exception for authentication failures, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: AuthorizationError
classes.description: Exception for authorization failures, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Exception for Segregation of Duties violations, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Exception for electronic signature validation failures, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid workflow state transitions, inherits from ApprovalError.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Main service class managing submission approval workflows, including e-signature verification, state transitions, and audit/evidence logging.

methods.name: verify_esign
methods.description: Verifies electronic signature credentials and creates a signed record.

methods.name: approve_submission
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of submissions with validation, state update, and evidence creation.

methods.name: _add_minutes_to_iso
methods.description: Utility method to add minutes to an ISO timestamp.
